description: Two managers: the Python project (pyproject.toml and uv.lock) and the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions. The 14-day wait matches uv's exclude-newer in pyproject.toml.

lockFileMaintenance.description: uv picks a refresh's versions, so the 14-day window is enforced there (exclude-newer). Renovate's own check cannot judge a refresh, which has no single release date, and would hold its status pending forever.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: A library declares the lowest versions it supports, and CI tests those floors (the lowest job). Raising a floor is a deliberate change, so Renovate moves uv.lock only and leaves pyproject.toml's ranges alone.
